archive_path.description: Glob pattern matching the built archive file

forbidden_patterns.description: Regex patterns forbidden inside the archive

max_entry_bytes.description: Entries larger than this many bytes are not scanned and are named in a note (default 16 MiB)

required_paths.description: Files required to exist inside the archive

scan_contents.description: Read each entry and report source maps whose sourcesContent embeds the original source, as .map entries or inline base64 sourceMappingURL comments

strip_components.description: Leading directory components to strip from archive paths

assert_helper_fns.description: Additional function names treated as assertions

extra_assert_macros.description: Additional macro names treated as assertions

min_assertions_per_test.description: Minimum assertions required per test method

mock_assert_fns.description: Callee fragments that assert on a test double's interactions, beyond the built-in vocabulary

mock_setup_fns.description: Callee fragments that construct or program a test double, beyond the built-in vocabulary

allow_cross_host.description: Allow benchmark comparison across mismatched host/runner provenance

base_file.description: In-job base benchmark result file path for dual-file regression checks

citation_measurement_jobs.description: CI jobs that produce gated numbers, each with the step that gates them. A cited run that concluded `failure` is admitted only when every listed job it started reached its guard step with every earlier step green. Empty: a cited `failure` run cannot be told from a crashed benchmark and leaves the gate armed.

citation_source_paths.description: Repo-relative files or directories whose changes can move a gated number. A cited data artifact last committed before the branch's newest change under these paths is stale. Empty: artifact citations cannot be dated and leave the gate armed.

exempt_arms.description: Benchmark arms exempted from regression checks: exact name, the name as the benchmark prints it (`map_get random` matches `map_get/random`), a glob (`*.heap.*`), a trailing-`*` prefix, or a `::`/`/` path suffix. An entry matching no arm in the run is an error.

head_file.description: In-job head benchmark result file path for dual-file regression checks

max_noise_cv.description: Maximum acceptable coefficient of variation (std_dev / mean)

mode.description: Evaluation mode: `version-vs-version` compares base and head artifacts of the same arms (preferred when the old version can be built in the same run); `paired-ratio` compares a ratio of two arms measured in the same interleaved rounds against a committed ratio baseline (when building the old version is impractical). The two are not interchangeable.

noise_margin_pct.description: Configurable noise margin added to tolerance_pct

paths.description: Benchmark artifact globs tracked across revisions

provenance.description: Expected host/runner provenance tag for benchmark artifacts

ratio_baseline.description: Committed paired-ratio baseline (`discipline-bench-ratio-baseline/v1`), produced by `discipline bench derive`. Read from the base ref, never from head; loosening it needs a scoped `allow-regression: <path>` directive.

ratio_tolerance_pct.description: Optional minimum paired-ratio threshold in percent. It only widens a derived floor; configured for an axis with no derived floor, it is a configuration error.

require_sourced_override.description: Require allow-regression reasons to cite a CI run URL or artifact path and name the arms. Every citation is also checked for freshness: a cited run must have completed, reached its regression guard, and measured a commit reachable from the head; a cited data artifact must post-date the branch's newest change under `citation_source_paths`. A citation that cannot be checked (no `gh`, unauthenticated, rate limited) is reported by name and leaves the gate armed.

diff_only.description: When true, scans only modified workflow files rather than all workflows

documented_job_count_path.description: Path to catalog documentation stating job count

documented_job_count_pattern.description: Regex pattern to extract job count from documentation

excluded_jobs.description: Job names excluded from rollup dependency requirements

first_party_action_prefixes.description: Action prefixes considered first-party and excused from commit SHA pinning

forbid_continue_on_error.description: Forbid continue-on-error: true in workflow jobs or steps

forbid_or_true.description: Forbid || true and set +e error masking in run commands

pin_actions.description: Ensure third-party GitHub actions are pinned by 40-character commit SHA

rollup_job.description: Name of the rollup job that must depend on all jobs

change_job.description: Change-detection job whose outputs gate the conditional jobs; it must have succeeded. Empty string = no such job

unconditional_jobs.description: Jobs that must never be skipped, whatever their dependencies did

workflow.description: Repo-relative path of the workflow whose rollup job supplies the runtime needs context (DISCIPLINE_CI_CONTEXT). Left at the default, the running workflow (GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF) or the first ci.yml under .github/, .gitea/ or .forgejo/workflows/ is used

allow_zero.description: Whether zero items selected is allowed

canary_expected_diagnostic.description: Expected diagnostic string that canary must produce

count_pattern.description: Regex pattern to extract an integer count

forbid_output.description: Output patterns that must not appear in stdout or stderr

name.description: Name or identifier of the command

preset.description: Predefined turnkey preset name (e.g. cargo-mutants, cargo-deny, loom)

zero_items_pattern.description: Pattern that indicates zero items were executed

allow_zero.description: Whether zero items selected is allowed

canary_expected_diagnostic.description: Expected diagnostic string that canary must produce

count_pattern.description: Regex pattern to extract an integer count

forbid_output.description: Output patterns that must not appear in stdout or stderr

preset.description: Predefined turnkey preset name (e.g. cargo-mutants, cargo-deny, loom)

zero_items_pattern.description: Pattern that indicates zero items were executed

agent_markers.description: Substrings of a trailer line, author name or author email that identify an agent-produced commit

required_trailers.description: Trailer keys every commit in the change must carry

review_trailer.description: Trailer an agent-produced commit must carry, naming someone other than its author; empty switches the rule off (default: Reviewed-by)

allow_hidden.description: When true, HTML-comment-wrapped directives are accepted for deletions

paths.description: Path globs where file deletions require a rationale

require_scope.description: When true, directive must name the deleted file or test

allow_dependencies.description: Explicit list of allowed dependency package names

allow_wildcards.description: Whether wildcard versions are permitted (default: false)

deny_dependencies.description: Explicit list of forbidden dependency package names

require_git_pins.description: Whether git dependencies must specify an immutable commit or tag pin (default: true)

paths.description: Committed golden/snapshot globs whose edits require a directive

approved_predicates.description: Conditional ignore predicates (e.g. miri) approved by policy

pattern.description: Custom regex pattern required in PR title or body

require_in_commit_if_no_pr.description: Require issue link in commit messages when no PR metadata is supplied

rules.description: Rules reconciling packaging manifests against git-tracked files

exclude_paths.description: Globs excluded from manifest registration requirement

extract_regex.description: Regex to extract relative file paths from manifest

watched_paths.description: Git file globs that must be registered in the manifest

guard.description: Name of the step in that job that reads the numbers and enforces the regression guard

job.description: Job display name as the CI API lists it

args.description: Additional CLI arguments passed to cargo miri test

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds before failing closed (default: 600)

command.description: Command to run to verify MSRV compatibility

agent_config_refs.description: When true, flags references to personal agent configuration directories and playbook docs

allowed_users.description: Username tokens permitted inside home-directory paths

diff_only.description: When true, scans only modified lines in the git diff rather than all tracked files

home_paths.description: Check for leaked home directory paths

hostname_denylist.description: Whole-token, case-insensitive hostnames that must not appear

lan_ips.description: Check for leaked private LAN IPs

redact_lan_ips.description: Mask a matched LAN IP in the report instead of echoing it (default: false)

scan_pr_body.description: Whether to scan PR description text

secrets.description: Check for leaked private keys and high-entropy API tokens

check_intervals.description: Check published wall-clock ratios for confidence intervals or explicit qualifiers

check_mechanisms.description: Check for mechanism claims without hardware counter evidence or explicit hypothesis qualifiers

check_paired_figures.description: Check paired figures for shared workload IDs or differentiation tags

check_pending_citations.description: A pending-measurement statement must cite a tracking issue

check_tables.description: Check markdown tables for unit-bearing numbers without table or caption provenance tags

deterministic_units.description: Units whose figures are deterministic and exempt from the interval requirement, added to the built-in list

diff_only.description: Judge only paragraphs that contain an added line (default: false, the whole changed file)

pending_issue_repos.description: Other repositories (owner/name) whose issues a pending statement may cite; by default only this repository's issues count

ratio_satisfied_by.description: What satisfies a published wall-clock ratio, replacing the built-in list when set: interval, marker:<word>, artifact:<glob>, regex:<pattern> (paragraph-scoped)

require_open_pending_issues.description: A pending-measurement statement must cite at least one open issue, read from the forge (gh on GitHub, curl on GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo); implies check_pending_citations

superseded_json_paths.description: Globs of tracked JSON datasets swept for registered figures

superseded_registry.description: Path (read at HEAD) of a JSON registry of withdrawn figures; a registered figure may be republished only next to a retraction marker

canary.description: Whether to verify a negative-control race canary before main tests

allowed_paths.description: Glob patterns of paths agents are authorized to modify

forbidden_paths.description: Glob patterns of paths agents are strictly forbidden to touch

paths.description: Directory and file globs that must never be tracked

Severity.description: Violation severity: error (blocking, exit 1), warning (non-blocking), or note (informational).

allow_patterns.description: Custom regex patterns exempted from violation

diff_only.description: When true, scans only modified lines in the git diff rather than all tracked files

extra_secret_patterns.description: Additional custom regex patterns for sensitive secret variable names

StringListOrReset.description: A list of strings, or a table with reset = true to clear lower precedence layers.

allowed_suppressions.description: Specific suppression patterns explicitly permitted by policy

max_increase.description: Maximum net increase in suppression annotations permitted (default: 0)

corpus_dirs.description: Corpus directory patterns to monitor for seed file shrink

constant_name.description: Name of the floor constant in constant_file

required_suites.description: Required test suite files that must exist

test_command.description: Custom command to list or count tests

tolerance.description: Allowed test count decrease below floor or base before violation (default: 0)

allow_patterns.description: Regex patterns permitted as operational exceptions; matched per line and across soft-wrapped lines of a paragraph, exempting only the matched text

diff_only.description: When true, scans only modified lines in the git diff rather than all tracked files

include.description: File globs swept for duration estimates

scan_pr_body.description: Whether to scan PR description text

allow_increase.description: Whether total unsafe count may increase over base ref without override

max_unsafe.description: Maximum total number of unsafe sites allowed in head ref

placeholders.description: Additional placeholder words or phrases to reject in SAFETY comments

groups.description: Groups of sources that must declare identical version strings

name.description: Name of the version lockstep group

sources.description: Files and capture regexes whose versions must match

regex.description: Regex pattern capturing the version string in group 1

description: Configuration schema for Discipline CI/CD gatekeeper and agent diff sentinel (discipline.toml)

directives.description: Policy controls for override directives (sources and visibility)

allow_hidden.description: Allow directives hidden inside HTML comments <!-- --> (default: false)

allowed_override_actors.description: Actors authorized to apply overrides even when fail_on_overrides is true, and the reviewers whose approval require_approval accepts (default: [])

degrade_offline.description: On a push event, continue with a named note when the merged-pr-body lookup fails, the finding it might have lifted standing, instead of stopping with exit 2 (default: true; set false to make the review record a hard requirement)

fail_on_overrides.description: Treat applied overrides as failures requiring human sign-off (default: false)

max_overrides.description: Most PR-body / commit-body overrides one change may apply; inline markers are not counted (default: unset, no cap)

require_approval.description: PR-body / commit-body overrides fail the run until the forge shows an approving review of the head commit by an allowed_override_actors member other than the author (default: false)

sources.description: Allowed directive sources: pr-body, commits, merged-pr-body (default: ["pr-body", "commits", "merged-pr-body"]). merged-pr-body reads, on a push event, the body of the merged pull request each pushed commit arrived through

gates.description: Per-gate settings. Each gate has a built-in default enablement and severity; see docs/GATES.md "Default Severity by Gate".

agent-scratch.description: agent scratch state is never tracked

agents-md.description: AGENTS.md exists; CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md do not fork it

archive-contents.description: distribution archive must contain required paths and zero forbidden developer artifacts

assertion-reduction.description: assertion count / strength must not drop in an existing test

bench-regression.description: benchmark drift via harness adapters (deterministic counts or BCa intervals)

build-hooks.description: install and build hooks that gain network or shell access, and package-manager configuration edits, need a token

ci-integrity.description: workflow weakening: continue-on-error, || true, unpinned actions

ci-skip-set.description: rollup skip set matches each job's `if:` under the observed filter outputs

command.description: fail-closed wrapper for any tool: zero-tests guard, canary, count ratchet

commit-provenance.description: commits carry the required trailers; an agent-produced commit carries a review by someone else

config-integrity.description: a change cannot weaken its own discipline.toml without a token

deletion-rationale.description: deleted files and removed tests need a scoped removes: rationale

dependency-delta.description: manifest diff inspection: zero wildcards, source/license allowlists, and deny.toml verification

error-swallowing.description: no new empty error handler or discarded Result outside tests

golden-output.description: prevents stealth edits to committed golden/test output files without explicit override

ignored-tests.description: tests must not be newly #[ignore]d or skipped without directive

instruction-smuggling.description: no invisible Unicode, unreviewed agent-instruction edits, or instruction-like text in comments and prose

issue-link.description: PR title or description links a tracking issue (#123, Fixes #123)

manifest-sync.description: reconcile git-tracked files against packaging manifest declarations

msrv.description: cargo check under the pinned MSRV

pii.description: no home paths, LAN IPs, or denylisted hostnames in tracked text

pr-checklist.description: ticked PR checkboxes are reconciled against the diff

sanitizers.description: ASan / TSan preset with audited suppressions and a race canary

shell-secrets.description: no command-line secrets or unverified piped scripts in shell, docker, or CI

stub-bodies.description: added functions are not stubs; existing bodies are not replaced by todo!() / NotImplementedError / return null

suppression-delta.description: newly added linter / compiler suppression annotations

test-budget.description: property-test and fuzz effort ratchet (cases, shrink iters, fuzztime, seed corpus)

test-floor.description: test-count ratchet read from the base ref

time-estimates.description: no calendar / duration estimates in markdown or the PR body

toolchain-config.description: compiler, linter, type-checker, test-runner and coverage configuration cannot be loosened without a token

unsafe-safety-comment.description: unsafe blocks / impls carry a // SAFETY: comment

vacuous-tests.description: new tests must carry a non-tautological assertion

version-lockstep.description: version declarations across headers, manifests, and files must remain in lockstep

meta.description: Repository metadata and configuration format version

description.description: Optional short description of the project

mode.description: Operating mode: 'enforcing' exits non-zero on violations; 'advisory' runs all checks and emits reports but exits 0.

tests.description: What the repository counts as test code beyond each language's conventions; read by every gate that separates test code from production code

functions.description: Function names (leaf) that are test entry points wherever they appear, e.g. a script's self_test (default: [])

paths.description: Path globs whose every line is test scope (default: [])
